**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Date:** April 17, 2025  
**Service:** Laparoscopic Adjustable Gastric Banding (CPT 43770)  
**Decision:** APPROVED

---

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement:** Met. Current BMI is 35.0 kg/m² (measured today), meeting the minimum threshold of 35 or greater. *(doc-002)*

**Obesity-Related Comorbidity:** Met. Patient has documented obstructive sleep apnea, an obesity-related condition actively managed in clinic. *(doc-003)*

**Prior Weight Management:** Met. Patient completed a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial. Despite intervention, net weight loss was only 2 kg and was regained after medication discontinuation, demonstrating unsuccessful conservative management. *(doc-004)*

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding is an approved bariatric procedure. *(order-005)*

---

This authorization is valid for 30 days from the date of this letter. Please schedule the procedure within this timeframe and notify us of the scheduled date.
